h:
请强制更新 kjnode、ltxv(comfyui)、gguf

v1.3

ltx2 新的 Samepler 节点更新,

整体音质有了明显的提升。图像质量似乎没有太大变化。

此外，新的采样器需要 i2v 中更高的图像强度。

请强制更新 kjnode、ltxv(comfyui)、gguf

v1.2

一些修复。

使用的 gguf 模型已更改。如果可能，请使用“ltx-2-19b-dev-Q8_0.gguf“通过不懒惰

v1.1

我们听说 Kijai 的 video_vae 由于一些问题而被更改。 vae 加载器也发生了变化。链接保持不变，请重新下载。

并且还需要强制更新kjnode。

这是我个人使用的工作流程。

所有必要的信息都记录在工作流程中。

T2V 和 I2V 都可以。

它在相同的计算机环境、相同的视频分辨率和视频长度下以与 Wan2.2 相似的规格运行。

在我的电脑环境中，

Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Q8_0 8步 16fps 300秒

ltx-2-19b-Distilled_Q8_0 8步欧拉 24fps 150秒

ltx-2-19b-Dev_Q8_0 20步欧拉 24fps 300秒

ltx-2-19b-Dev_Q8_0 20步 res_2s 24fps 450秒

我有 24gb vram、32gb 系统 ram，但它在 -novram 下运行良好，所以它应该在 8gb vram 上运行良好。

如果使用 -novram 运行它，生成时间将大约延长两倍。

如果可能，请尽可能长时间地保留提示。如果它们太短，可能会出现错误或可能会增加意想不到的效果。请务必包含足够的场景描述和对话。

o.en:
plz force update kjnode, ltxv(comfyui), gguf

v1.3

ltx2 new samepler nodeupdate,

The overall sound has been significantly improved. Image quality doesn't seem to have changed much.

Also, the new sampler requires more image strength in i2v.

plz force update kjnode, ltxv(comfyui), gguf

v1.2

some fix.

The gguf model used has changed. If possible, please use "ltx-2-19b-dev-Q8_0.gguf" by unsloth

v1.1

We've heard that Kijai's video_vae has been changed due to an som issues. The vae loader has also changed. The link remains the same, so please download it again.

And you also need to force update kjnode.

This is the workflow I personally use.

All necessary information is noted within the workflow.

Both T2V and I2V are possible.

It runs with similar specs to Wan2.2 in the same computer environment, same video resolution and video length.

In my computer environment,

Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Q8_0 8step 16fps 300sec

ltx-2-19b-Distilled_Q8_0 8step euler 24fps 150sec

ltx-2-19b-Dev_Q8_0 20step euler 24fps 300sec

ltx-2-19b-Dev_Q8_0 20step res_2s 24fps 450sec

I have 24gb vram, 32gb system ram, but it runs fine with -novram, so it should work fine with 8gb vram.

If you run it with -novram, the generation time will be about twice as long.

If possible, keep your prompts as long as possible. If they're too short, errors may occur or unintended effects may be added. Be sure to include sufficient scene descriptions and dialogue.
